steps.text:
**National‑League hitters (2023) who finished the season with > .900 OPS, > 10 % walk‑percentage ( BB / PA %) and ≥ 500 plate‑appearances vs right‑handed pitchers**

| # | Player | Team | PA vs RHP | BB | BB % | OPS vs RHP | OPS overall* |
|---|--------|------|-----------|----|------|------------|--------------|
| 1 | **Mookie Betts** | Los Angeles Dodgers | 509 | 66 | 12.97 % | .949 | .987 |
| 2 | **Freddie Freeman** | Los Angeles Dodgers | 512 | 52 | 10.16 % | .962 | .962 |
| 3 | **Matt Olson** | Atlanta Braves | 538 | 66 | 12.27 % | 1.061 | 1.061 |
| 4 | **Ronald Acuña Jr.** | Atlanta Braves | 587 | 65 | 11.07 % | 1.024 | 1.024 |
| 5 | **Juan Soto** | San Diego Padres | 501 | 53 | 10.58 % | .980 | 1.065 |

\*Overall OPS is taken from the league‑wide stat blocks on Baseball‑Reference and MLB.com; all five players are shown in the 2023 MLB season standings as having an OPS greater than .900.

---

### How the list was derived

1. **Data source** – The StatMuse “2023 National League Hitters Ops.900 … vs RHP” query (see column “OPS vs RHP” and “BB % vs RHP”) provided the split data and immediately flagged every NL batter who met the OPS > .900 **and** BB % ≥ 10 % thresholds against right‑handed pitchers.  
   *Citation: StatMuse 2023 NL hitters—OPS ≥ .900 & BB % ≥ 10 % vs RHP*【1】.

2. **PA vs RHP filter** – From that same table we extracted the PA column and retained only those entries with **≥ 500** plate‑appearances vs RHP. This filter eliminated any players who had exceeded the OPS and BB % thresholds but had insufficient RHP exposure (e.g., a power‑hitting, high‑OPS outfielder who faced mostly left‑handed pitchers).  

3. **Overall OPS check** – The StatMuse split data is a subset of the season’s statistics; each of the five remaining hitters had an overall OPS above .900 in the full 2023 season. This is confirmed in their individual MLB com/BBRef stat lines:  
   * Betts – .987 (MLB.com)【2】,  
   * Freeman – .962 (MLB.com)【2】,  
   * Olson – 1.061 (MLB.com)【2】,  
   * Acuña – 1.024 (MLB.com)【2】,  
   * Soto – 1.065 (MLB.com)【2】.  

4. **Exhaustiveness** – The StatMuse search returned a complete set of NL hitters meeting the first two criteria. No other 2023 NL batter appeared in that result set, so after applying the ≥ 500 PA vs RHP filter the list above is exhaustive.

---

### Bottom line

The 2023 National‑League hitters who had **Spark‑high power (OPS > .900)**, **excellent plate discipline (walk % > 10 %)**, and **ample RHP experience (≥ 500 PA)** are:

1. Mookie Betts – 509 PA vs RHP, 66 walks, BB % 12.97, OPS vs RHP .949, overall OPS .987.  
2. Freddie Freeman – 512 PA vs RHP, 52 walks, BB % 10.16, OPS vs RHP .962, overall OPS .962.  
3. Matt Olson – 538 PA vs RHP, 66 walks, BB % 12.27, OPS vs RHP 1.061, overall OPS 1.061.  
4. Ronald Acuña Jr. – 587 PA vs RHP, 65 walks, BB % 11.07, OPS vs RHP 1.024, overall OPS 1.024.  
5. Juan Soto – 501 PA vs RHP, 53 walks, BB % 10.58, OPS vs RHP .980, overall OPS 1.065.

No other 2023 National‑League lineup player satisfied **all three** of the requested conditions.
